audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and First item rendered as Skill/Tahm Kench/Tahm Kench/Tahm Kench while their whys all describe Quinn winning: 'W steroid online gives you the attack and move speed to kite', 'stack burst trades he can only grey-health-tank', 'You convert the lead into plates', 'Your lethality/crit spike shreds his real HP'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Quinn x6, Tahm Kench] and Quinn wins 52.72% over 294 games. The rendered sides were the opposite of every reason printed beneath them.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped to Quinn in both layers as one atomic group with ratings raised; row 6 stays Tahm Kench, which packet and prose agree on.

audit.why: Quinn levels 1-3, level 6 roam, first-item lethality, Tahm Kench as a two-item drain tank — right and ordered. Rank-1 numbers now attached: Tongue Lash 7s / 900 range, Abyssal Dive 21s / 1000 range from level 2.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. Tongue Lash is called 'his stun' unconditionally — it only stuns a target already carrying 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste; otherwise it damages, slows, and HEALS him. wants.foe[0] calls it a root, which it never is. And Devour is attributed to W in four places ('W-devour windows', 'his W devour', 'dive with W', 'Use W devour') — Devour is R; W is Abyssal Dive, a 1000-range knockup.
audit.why: Riot text for Q: 'If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' Riot text for W: 'Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.' Riot text for R: 'Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds.' The mirror audit reached the same conclusion on the stack condition and on Tongue Lash cancelling Behind Enemy Lines.
audit.corrected: Stack condition stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d; Devour reattributed to R and Abyssal Dive named as the W knockup; the channel cancel recorded.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Tongue Lash's cooldown' is the wrong clock at 7s — the tracked resource is the STACK count, not the cooldown.
audit.why: Stacks decay, so Vaulting out of his range for a few seconds resets the threat entirely. The mirror audit records the same finding from the other side: Vault removes you from range so existing stacks time out before the third lands.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now tells the player to Vault away and let stacks expire rather than count a 7s cooldown.

audit.why: report[8].t buys early anti-heal, which is right: Tongue Lash heals him on champion hit and Thick Skin converts stored damage into healing out of combat, so chip poke without Grievous Wounds achieves nothing.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Tongue Lash: matchup-defining — His stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tongue Lash (Q): 7s at rank 1, 900 range — it only STUNS at 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, otherwise it slows and heals him. It also cancels Behind Enemy Lines. - Abyssal Dive (W, 21s) is the knockup.

edits.before: Track Tahm Kench's Tongue Lash: His stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Tongue Lash stuns only at 3 An Acquired Taste stacks — Vault away and the stacks expire first.

edits.before: His stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It stuns only on the third stack — before that it is a slow.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Abyssal Dive knocks you up from 1000 range at 21s — sidestep it.

edits.before: Lethality/crit spike (Serrated Dirk into your crit item) lets you shred his actual HP between W-devour windows before he stacks resists.
edits.after: Lethality/crit spike (Serrated Dirk into your crit item) lets you shred his real HP through Thick Skin's shield before he stacks resists.

edits.before: Land Q tongue to root you in place so his autos and grey-health trades actually connect
edits.after: Stack An Acquired Taste to three, then Tongue Lash for the stun and a free trade

edits.before: Use W devour and R to threaten dives and roams that punish your squishy frame
edits.after: Dive with Abyssal Dive and Devour (R) to punish your squishy frame in a collapse

notes: The mirror audit flags a champion-wide problem worth escalating: champ-data/content/tahmkench.js contains 182 occurrences of 'Abyssal Voyage', the pre-rework W, which does not exist on the live champion — the current W is Abyssal Dive. Quinn's page inherited the same confusion in the opposite direction, attributing Devour to W. I fixed the instances that fit the band; 'his W devour' in mid and 'dive with W' in late remain. Packet games (294) disagrees with the brief's top-level games (362).
